_doc: Which benchmark task belongs to which task set (AUDIT_SOP Phase 4, 'Two task sets, always reported separately'). bench/_make_plan.py and bench/analyze.py read this file; every task file also states its set on its second line.

pre-registered.description: The fair test. Written and frozen on 2026-11-10 (first freeze f9e60755, then e27c0aac), before the usability change list existed. Prompts and checker criteria unchanged since then.

friction-derived.description: Built on 2026-11-10 from the jobs of the friction session (FRICTION-REPORT-20261110), AFTER the usability changes were designed. It exercises what those changes target and therefore favours the usability build by construction; it is never pooled with the pre-registered set.

max_turns_rule: 40 for single-object tasks, 60 for multi-object tasks (the rule of the 2026-11-10 plan, itself the Grafana plan's 40 / 60)
